audacity.alt: Audacity logo: blue headphones over a yellow and red sound wave
audacity.usageStatement: The SVG metadata states cc:license GPL v2 or later, dc:rights Audacity development team, dc:creator Aaron Spike, dc:date 2009-06-14. The repository LICENSE.txt says Audacity is released under GPLv3 and that an individual file may state another licence. This file states GPL v2 or later. No separate permission to use the logo as a trademark was found.
audacity.match: Project logo shipped in the current Audacity source tree. It is the long-standing headphones logo, not a screenshot of a particular editor release.
